deploy-bot: [AUTO] rollout 3.5.2 -> production: embedding quality regression detected on /v1/embeddings (cosine drift +4.2% over 30m). Recommendation: HOLD rollout and fallback to r-3.5.1 for embeddings only. See telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/rollouts/4311123456 :warning:
anna: oncall, can someone triage the quantization flags? this looks like the int8 fastpath we enabled in the last build.
mira: confirmed — prod embeddings nodes had flag `--quant-mode=int8-fast` flipped in the kernel build at 11:02. perf looks good but quality dipped on our eval set.
sam: agree we should avoid a full revert. proposal: route embeddings traffic back to r-3.5.1 (no change to generation/chat routes). low blast radius.
leo: routing-only rollback is fine. ops-runner, can you execute a partial traffic pin and then drain KV caches for embeddings so we don't mix caches across model versions?
ops-runner: will do. plan: 1) set routing weight 100% -> r-3.5.1 for service `embeddings` 2) drain in-flight requests 3) evict KV cache on nodes with quant flag. running commands below and will post statuses.
ops-runner: ```
# switch embeddings route
deployctl route set --service embeddings --target-version r-3.5.1 --weight 100 --reason "auto-hold embedding quality regression"
# drain kv cache
deployctl node exec --selector embedding-prod "rm -rf /var/run/kvcache/* && systemctl restart embedding-worker"
```
oncall-bot: NOTE: changing routing weight triggers alert cooldown; set `--silent` if you want no pager for the change.
anna: do we want to update release notes / customer comms? sales asked if this would affect any customers using dedicated pools.
support-lead: brief note for support: "Embeddings route temporarily rolled back to the previous model version due to quality regression. No impact to other features. We are investigating and will update when resolved." I'll post to #support and update the incident template.
mira: investigating build artifact differences now. hypothesis: a kernel selector change caused different ordering in quant kernels leading to small vector drift. pulling diffs from the build: https://ci.internal/builds/7823/diff
sam: good. timeline: ops-runner will execute the routing change, we monitor eval set and customer telemetry for 30m. if metrics stabilize, keep pins until root cause fixed. if not, escalate to full rollback.
ops-runner: executing route switch now. will comment when done. :gear:
ops-runner: done — routing set to r-3.5.1 for embeddings. command returned 0. monitoring.
mira: started pairwise eval run against the internal probe suite. ETA ~12m.
anna: flagged release notes draft with a short blurb about embedding rollback. also notified account teams for customers with dedicated embeddings pools so they can opt-in/opt-out.
support-lead: posted to #support and added a canned reply for CS: "We're currently routing embeddings to the previous model due to a temporary quality issue; no further action required on your side."
ops-runner: KV caches evicted on 3/4 nodes, restarting workers on the last node now.
oncall-bot: Reminder: manual overrides require two approvers within eng-releases for non-blocking change windows.
leo: I'm +1 on holding the pin. Mira, please ping when you have root cause. If eval shifts back to normal, we can unpin and re-enable the fast int8 path behind a canary with a smaller sample.
mira: initial eval shows cosine drift reduced to +0.3% after rollback — looks promising. collecting full trace to root cause.
anna: thanks everyone. assign follow-up to mira (root cause) and sam (rollout strategy). ops-runner you own the rollback exec. I'll keep exec comms to legal/marketing as needed. :thumbsup:
ops-runner: ack, will keep this thread updated with timestamps and final revert/unpin decision.
